propositions: rebar doctor lacked visibility into lock hold state (held/free, holder identity, liveness, hold age); operators had no diagnostic surface and resorted to manual filesystem inspection
lock health checks must expose four legs (tickets-write fcntl, tickets-write mkdir, hlc, enrich-drain) with held/free/absent state and holder liveness/age metadata for mkdir leg only
held locks with live holders report INFO and do not trigger findings or exit code change; stale or dead-holder locks generate findings and exit 1
doctor remains read-only: staleness decisions inherit exclusively from lock_owner._mkdir_lock_is_stale, no independent heuristic is introduced, and --repair performs no lock mutations
doctor reports same-host-only liveness verdicts (live/not-running/unprobeable) and reports foreign-host or different-namespace holders as unprobeable rather than guessing pid state
